# Run and publish the real Slice 1 Anth.us story

## Purpose

Operate the selected genuine article through the proven pod mechanics and collect unedited evidence from the real workflow.

## Deliverables

- Create the real story through Kanbus and complete idea, assignment, research, report, editorial selection, and copywriting artifacts.
- Use only supported transitions, including revision paths if the editor requests changes.
- Preserve internal research/reporting separately from reader-facing copy.
- Publish the approved marked article into Anth.us and pass the divergence check.
- Capture coaching, blocks, recovery, bypass attempts, false positives, and human interventions as the run occurs.
- Follow the Anth.us repository delivery rules for the actual published article.

## Implements

- PPY-aad877: one real end-to-end story.

## Verification

The real post is published from the pod source, the Kanbus history contains every transition, and the evidence record can be evaluated without relying on the agent conversation.
